title: Qualify retained formatter arguments on both original Spring releases
description: Use ordinary numbered setup, watcher preflight and build resume on Spring 458. Compare two initial flags on both original releases. Compile and run the genuine caller, a separate equal formatter and an early getter. Compare plain and traced JVM outputs and require the independent identity and order checks to reject both planted callers.
expected: All four genuine histories qualify and all eight output-identical planted histories lose qualification.

steps.name: Numbered handoff and original JVM checks
